summary.text: Tom Davis is a Republican member of the South Carolina Senate for District 46, which covers Beaufort and Jasper Counties, serving since 2009.
He is an attorney and chairs the Senate Labor, Commerce and Industry Committee.

paragraphs.text: Davis was born on May 31, 1960, in New Brunswick, New Jersey.
His official page lists a B.A. from Furman University in 1982 and a J.D. from the University of Maryland School of Law in 1985, and says he was admitted to the South Carolina Bar in 1985.
He co-managed Mark Sanford's 2002 and 2006 gubernatorial campaigns and served in Sanford's administration as senior policy advisor, co-chief of staff, deputy chief of staff and chief of staff.

He has been in the Senate since 2009, and his committees are Banking and Insurance, Corrections and Penology, Finance, Labor, Commerce and Industry (chairman), Legislative Oversight and Medical Affairs.
